name: Rust Fix — Syntax Errors
description: Fix basic syntax errors in Rust programs: missing semicolons, unmatched braces, typos.

tasks.description: A file called greet.rs has a missing semicolon. Fix it so 'rustc greet.rs' compiles successfully.
tasks.expected_outcome: greet.rs compiles with rustc without errors

tasks.description: A file called math.rs has an unmatched closing brace. Fix it so 'rustc math.rs' compiles.
tasks.expected_outcome: math.rs compiles with rustc without errors

tasks.description: A file called hello.rs has a keyword typo. Fix it so 'rustc hello.rs' compiles and runs producing 'Hello, Rust!'.
